title: Romualdez ‘does not leave’ jail, says Remulla; court wants CCTV review
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Thursday rejected allegations that House Speaker Martin Romualdez was clandestinely allowed to leave the Quezon City Jail.
